reviews.text:
I have a cat, she's a bit of a jerk. These people help to keep her alive so I can continue to receive mild affection and indifference.

They are nice and helpful.

We’ve been at this vet for a few years. Our dog got spayed here with great recovery and the staff kept us in the loop. When she got cut open we took her to an emergency vet and Granville island vet called to check in on how she was doing even though they didn’t do the procedure. Recently we had two teeth that were fractured so we got a few extractions. The staff are polite, friendly, and fast responding. I’ve always felt comfortable leaving our dog with them and no surprises with extra fees. The estimates or quotes are fairly spot on. We’ve really enjoyed the care we’ve gotten for our dog.

We were visiting Vancouver for two days with our senior dog; we realized that we forgot to pack his heart medication in our haste to get out of the house. We eventually contacted Granville Island Veterinary Hospital seeking an emergency prescription to cover our short vacation stay. We had tried a few veterinary clinics associated with the big chain providers who all required that we pay for an examination before they would assist. The staff at GIVH were amazing and worked with our own veterinarian to obtain the necessary documentation for the prescription. They were excellent to deal with and the cost was nominal. I can understand how they get amazing reviews, they just care about your pet. If I lived here, I would not hesitate enrolling my pet as a patient.

Used to be the go to place in Metro Vancouver if you didn't want to visit the incredibly pricey 24 Hour Emergency Clinic across the street. Now, few honourable people enter the veterinary especially medical profession. So sad.

The best vet hospital! We’ve been seeing Dr. Chan, and she is incredibly gentle, warm, and careful with my dog. I trust Dr. Chan 100%, as well as the other doctors here. I love that they send detailed summaries after every visit so I never miss anything. I also really appreciate that I’ve never felt pressured into any unnecessary treatments. I highly recommend them if you are looking for a new vet for your baby!

I recently moved into the area and took my 2 cats to an initial appointment and exam that went well. I was told my one cat needed an additional blood test, so I tried to email them to book an appointment. I'm hard of hearing so it can be difficult for me to communicate on the phone, email is much easier. I got a reply saying I needed to call their office to book an appointment. I emailed again asking if it would be at all possible to book by email instead, and I explained the reason is because of my hearing loss. I got an automatic reply saying they received my message and would reply within 24 hours. 3 days later I still hadn't heard from them, so I decided this vet office is probably not a good fit for me and I should find a different vet that accommodates email communication requests. Posting about it here just so other hard of hearing folks have the information.

I recently had to say goodbye to my Shepherd, Walter of almost 14 years. The support and professionalism by Dr. Chu made this experience very comfortable and manageable. This is an amazing veterinary office full of love and integrity. Thank you.

We have had several visits over the past 12 years for our beloved Boxer Oliver. Every time he was cared for with so much love. It was devastating to have to say goodbye to the bestest boy ever, but Granville Island helped us thru and gave our good boy a good-bye with dignity and love. I'm grateful for all the staff for the kindness. We were blessed to have him for so long. Thank-you

We’ve been through a few vets in the city and this one has stuck with us!  They’re kind and compassionate vets, techs and receptionists. Our animals are well cared for and loved by the staff, including sending a condolence card when one of our pets passed away. A little more pricy, but you get what you pay for and we are happy to pay a little extra for them to go the extra mile.

Had both dogs getting spayed in this vet years ago and it was all great !
I recently had one dog getting teeth surgery done there ( she is 7 yrs old and removed 6 teeth ) and I went Beyond of my expectations !!
They did the bloodwork and got results in the same day as the surgery ( not on a diff day like other vets tend to do ) did X-rays and the Doctor called me during the procedure to give me an update on how many teeth she was planning to remove to see if that was ok with me ( I had my other dog doing the exact same surgery on Yaletown Vet/VCA and the care and treatment was COMPLETELY different ) today we went for a teeth checkup and they gave us a care package for my dogs teeth and a recommendation or products for dog dental hygiene approved by vets - really amazing care! We absolutely love how attentive staff is every single time;
It’s worth every penny! We will Keep coming back (:

Just ended the call. Called to ask what the cost was to have my new female kitten spayed when the time came. Lady on the phone kept dancing around on the point.

How can you not have a printed rate sheet where the prices for various procedures are set? What is this nonsense about having to have a doctor consult on the price? It should be a fixed cost.

If you cannot give a straight answer to a simple question, how can anyone trust your clinic? It's desexing a kitten. Not extended cancer treatments or anything with open ended variables. What is the cost for the procedure? Are there any other associated costs? That's it!!
Best vets! We've been going here for over 25 years!!
The staff members are exceptionally kind and patient with the animals. Dr. Wallace is truly remarkable.
I've been bringing my dogs here since Max nearly 20 years ago. The doctors are always so kind and patient and gentle! My current CKCS named Chester is also a big hit with the vet techs!

Dr Ignacio was my Lab, Champ’s vet for 16yrs and now my rescue dog, Charm’s for 4yrs.  He’s got great bedside manner & always gives me facts, options then lets me make my own decisions.

Highly recommend him at Granville Island Veterinary Clinic!

My dog was really struggling to walk up stairs as she had significant stiffness and pain.  Meds alone weren’t resolving it.  We went to Dr. Wallace for acupuncture on the recommendation of someone at the dog beach.  I was skeptical, but WOW!  What a difference!  She’s now able to go up and down stairs as well as get up from her bed without struggling.  Seriously surprising result.

There is still further investigation to be done to figure out the root cause of the issue, but in the meantime time, acupuncture has really helped tremendously.

Thank you to Dr. Wallace, Dr. Chan (wonderful bedside manner), and all the techs and front desk staff for being so great!
Frankie always feels comfortable coming here for his annual checkups

Dr. Chiu and her staff have been great.  We have a rescue pup who gets nervous and Dr. Chiu and her staff have been nothing but kind and professional about ensuring she has the best experience possible.  Thanks team!
Great service and I feel like they really care about my dog.

This has been my Frenchie's primary vet clinic for several years now, and over that time we've probably been to see every vet that is on staff there and they are all so lovely. They really care about the animals that they serve there and you can tell. Special shout out to Dr. Rose. She's amazing with my senior pooch, almost like she loves him as much as I do.

We took our sweet boy in today for a first time visit after reading the great reviews. He was feeling under the weather and kept us up all night with a cough. The reviews don't lie, we felt cared for at every turn. The administration booked us in efficiently and, unlike vet clinics we've dealt with in the past, weren't pushy or impatient at all. The facilities were clean and extremely put together. The price absolutely reflects the quality of service. We didn't once feel like we were backed into anything we wouldn't need.

Dr. Celena Wu made us feel comfortable and confident from beginning to end. She was gentle, calm, caring, personable, and incredibly thorough. She was well-spoken and gave us all of the information we would need from the examination. She went above and beyond our expectations and we are really happy with our visit, and the clinic. We will be back for a check-up after the round of prescribed meds, and can rest easy knowing we have a great, trustworthy clinic in our neighbourhood.

Thanks for all of your great work!

Edit: I've unfortunately had to visit here more times than I'd like in the past few months so I've dealt with much of the staff (3 different vets) and I'm continuously blown away by everyone's care, compassion, clarity, and communication. I genuinely can't say enough good things about this pet clinic :) we feel so much safer with Granville Island Vet Hospital as Benji's vets!

I've updated my review based on more caring time with Casey Chiu from Granville Island vet now that my pup has moved to pup heaven. Hands down I would refer them to ANYONE. They've always treated my dog Zoey just like she's their own (especially Casey Chiu who helped us with Zoey's cancer on her past past years). All the staff are VERY friendly and you can tell they all genuinely love animals. I've been taking my dog here for her entire life (10.5 years) and would recommend everyone do. Thank you Dr Chiu for making Zoey and our final days with cancer a little bit easier. Until her last breath Zoey loved going to see Dr Chiu and the other staff at Granville Island, they will always be in my heart for caring for her.
Great veterinary care at the Granville Island Veterinary Hospital. I have been taking dogs there for almost 9 years and couldn’t be happier with the care they received.
So happy to have a vet I trust so much.
Hands down the best vet I have ever been to. The staff is so friendly. And the vet we saw was amazing. Made us feel right at home.
Amazing and lovely veterinarians. Excellent expertise and customer service. Front desk staff are incredibly kind and thorough. Thank you everyone for taking care of Bruno!
Great veterinarian, they take amazing care of our pets - they also said my cat was very handsome, which I appreciated 👍 …

I recently took my dog to Granville Animal Hospital for a doggy dental and a needed 2 extractions. I did a lot of research prior and had a meet and greet exam with owner Dr. Bill Ignacio prior. I instantly felt at ease. He and his team took great care of my terrier Benji who did just great post op. They provide great care and value. My dog will continue on as a patient. I would recommend this clinic to my friends.

My normal vet clinic is closed today and I need an emergency quick subconscious fluid treatment from a vet tech and since this was the next closest vet that was open I called them. They had a vet tech available and I had a referral from my cats usual vet but instead of helping my cat they said since I don't have a long standing relationship with them they can't see my cat. It sounds to me like they are putting business over animal care and it was painful to hear from a hospital. I would not recommend!

Words cannot describe how amazing this vet is. They truly treat your pets like their own. They are so kind and caring and go above and beyond to make your pets feel comfortable. My elderly dog gets very anxious at the vet and they accommodated every one of his (many) needs and did everything they could to make him feel comfortable.

Had a couple incidents where I needed help/advice over the phone and the vets did not hesitate to step in and support us.

Our previous vet (at a different clinic) was horrible, cold and uneducated and switching over to Dr. Wallace was the best decision I ever made. She has done everything she can to help my dog’s last few months are comfortable and pain free. Highly recommend!

Today was the hardest day of my life. I said goodbye to my senior pup Mabel. I can’t say enough about the staff and entire team. From the moment I called they were kind and helpful. Thank you Dr. Clare for being so wonderful, gentle and patient, and Jade for your support and kindness. It truly meant a lot and I can’t thank you enough.
Had a bad experience with their receptionist with a passive-aggressive attitude. What a way to treat worrying pet owners.

I'm reminded today (waiting for a call back from them) how happy we are with the care we've received here. Everyone's been so kind to our dogs, and patient with us, and while it's difficult to get an emergency appointment (I guess that's what animal emergency hospitals are for), it's usually not difficult to get a soon-ish appointment. And they have their own parking spaces, which is just one less worry. Very pleased to have chosen them as our vet (different doctors have been treating little Cody, and they've all been great).

A big thank you to the whole team but especially to Dr Rose. She was able to get my anxious dog to relax for the exam, she was extremely professional and skilled, she connected with me for follow-up and was supportive throughout the illness. Thank you!

I didn’t end up visiting this place but had a life-changing first call with the team here. I called a number of clinics with a lot of anxiety because we’ve been through many vets but our cat was not getting any better. At that time the Granville Island vet hospital had no capacity, but the staff who took our call actually saved our cat’s eyes. No other clinics I called tried to understand our cat’s eye situation over the phone nor making recommendations of what next steps to consider.
My senior cat was suffering from a number of issues including serious eye problems that took 3 other clinics that have been only delaying effective treatments. The staff here who took my call recommended that I seek referral to a specialist instead, saying even in their hospital they usually refer eye patients to specialists - because the specialists hold more expertise and would know better what is the problem and how to treat effectively.
I later went to my vet and asked for their help referring my cat to a specialist. The specialist team called me within only a few hours to understand my cat’s situation, and determined its emergency and arranged appointment the next day. Within few minutes at the specialist’s it was diagnosed: a very rare glaucoma that even the specialist only sees one or two per year. With the right medication our cat’s eyes were saved! I am so ever grateful for the recommendation from the call I had with the Granville Island vet team, thank you for listening to my panic call and making the recommendations even knowing an appointment with me was not possible due to capacity. Big heart to you all with love!
A very kind and professional clinic. Everyone was wonderful and amazing with our a pup.

What a great vet hospital! The team is polite and professional. Dr Rose is amazing. In 8 years as a cat owner in Vancouver and 5 different vets, she is the best vet I’ve met: she takes her time, is comforting, really listens, really cares and respect your budget with trying to charge you extra service. I could not recommend this clinic enough!

We’ve trusted this clinic with our Sharpei, Wesley, for years, and we couldn’t be happier with the care he’s received. Wesley has been through a lot, and the staff has always been incredibly helpful and friendly. Dr. Bill is amazing—he truly listens and takes the time to address all of our concerns. I originally came here on the recommendation of a client, and now I confidently recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, top-notch care for their pets!

I have been happy about the Granville Island Veterinary Hospital for years, but things started to go downhill since my last visit. Not only did they increase their prices DRASTICALLY without notice, even though I asked for a quote (approx. 20 % more on my last bill, for the exact same services), but the guidance I received after my cat got diagnosed with CKD was also more than disappointing. The vet told me she needed a kidney food diet, but didn't tell me I had to go through them to purchase the food, nor that they offered samples, so I did extensive research online and in stores, only to find out CKD food is only available through your vet. I was really not impressed with the help I received to find a suitable diet for my cat.
Incredible staff, service and doctors. The best I’ve ever been to. Love this place.
Thanks to Dr Chan, our Momo regained her health. The clinic was clean. All staff of the clinic were knowledgeable, kind, caring and professional.

These are the best vets in Vancouver! I have major trust issues with vets because I’ve had bad experiences with others, but everyone at Granville Island Veterinary is amazing. You can tell they really care about the animals. The front desk staff are very kind too, and they were so supportive when I had to say goodbye to my senior dog.

Best veterinarians in the city, hands down.

Edited years later because my Cat is 23 years old and the efforts of this exceptional staff have been a significant part of that.

I can’t speak highly enough of Dr. Rose and her incredible team. Every visit to the clinic is a reminder of how fortunate we are to have found such dedicated and compassionate care for our pets. Dr. Rose not only shows genuine concern for the well-being of our animals but also takes the time to connect with us as pet owners. Her thoughtful approach, combined with the professionalism and kindness of her staff, truly sets this clinic apart. We always leave feeling confident that our pets are in the best possible hands. Highly recommend!
